recipe.ghg_method: Fossil CO2 summed across seven native fuel accounts. Source Mt CO2eq converted to tonnes using 1e6. CO2 has GWP 1 under AR5 and AR6; no CH4, N2O or F-gases are included. No direct final-demand emissions are supplied. EMERGING-E has no published CO2 companion: the EMERGING 2.2 companion for the same year (133 sectors) is projected onto the 146 EMERGING-E sectors; aggregated electricity CO2 is assigned to the 14 electricity technologies by fuel.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP proxy: value added (no product-tax detail in source)
recipe.gdp_note: EMERGING: GDP is approximated by value added. The source table does not break out product taxes, so no adjustment to market prices is applied.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the native value added row. The source table does not break out product taxes separately.
recipe.attribution: Huo, J. EMERGING-E, 2018. doi:10.5281/zenodo.18303090. CC BY 4.0; indicators calculated with MARIO.
recipe.ghg_basis: Fossil CO2 by fuel; incomplete GHG proxy
recipe.gwp_basis: CO2 only (GWP = 1 under AR5 and AR6)
recipe.ghg_note: EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included. EMERGING-E has no published CO2 companion: the EMERGING 2.2 companion for the same year (133 sectors) is projected onto the 146 EMERGING-E sectors; aggregated electricity CO2 is assigned to the 14 electricity technologies by fuel.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied. EMERGING reports one household consumption category; its NPISH coverage is undocumented. The displayed value is the reported household amount, not a verified complete SNA Households + NPISH amount. No missing NPISH amount is treated as zero.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed. Unallocated production value added: 0.042 USD globally (signed native-currency result). Direct unrepresented production accounts and upstream requirements outside observed final demand stay by production origin.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included. EMERGING-E has no published CO2 companion: the EMERGING 2.2 companion for the same year (133 sectors) is projected onto the 146 EMERGING-E sectors; aggregated electricity CO2 is assigned to the 14 electricity technologies by fuel. Unallocated production emissions: 13,000.027 t CO2eq globally; direct unrepresented accounts and requirements outside observed final demand are retained by production origin, without a consumer allocation.
